changelog: Fixed: When this PC's activation is reset or removed from your license, UltraGrab Pro now asks you to activate this PC again (same PC, no extra device slot) instead of showing a server error
Fixed: A license-server answer that only a proxy, captive portal or unexpected response could produce no longer affects this PC's saved activation
Improved: When all devices of a license are in use, or this PC is still registered, the message explains how to free it in the Account Portal (Devices > Reset Activation)
Improved: A suspended, cancelled or not-yet-started license is now described as such instead of always as expired
